origin.description: Extracts by character position and reopens the active SGR.
origin.usage: substr_ctl(x, start, stop, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), term.cap = getOption("fansi.term.cap", dflt_term_cap()), ctl = "all", normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: Extracts by character position and reopens the active SGR.
origin.value: A character vector, or a list of character vectors for strsplit.

translation.description: Extracts by character position and reopens the active SGR.
translation.usage: substr_ctl(x, start, stop, warn=None, term_cap=None, ctl="all", normalize=None, carry=None, terminate=None)
translation.details: Extracts by character position and reopens the active SGR. A string is one element. None is a missing string. The replacement functions are substr_ctl_replace and substr2_ctl_replace.
translation.value: A list of strings, or a list of lists for strsplit.
translation.example:
from fansi.substr_ctl import substr_ctl
print(substr_ctl("\033[42mhello\033[m world", 1, 9, warn=False)[0])
